slice: SOCIAL-01 token refresh and provider revocation

checks.broaderHttpAttempts: Incomplete: two harness runs ended without a final test receipt; not counted as passes.

behavior: Owner/admin refresh under organization row lock, encrypted access and rotated offline grant; safe metadata response.
Owner/admin provider revoke first durably blocks local publishing attempts; unconfirmed provider result retains encrypted grant for explicit retry.
Confirmed provider revocation clears stored refresh grant and access expiry. Pending revoked grants block OAuth reconnect.
Tenant and role denials, provider failures, refresh rotation, retry and reconnect are isolated HTTP tested.
limits: No live Google grant, revocation or test post; provider methods are isolated fixtures.

Provider refresh network call holds organization transaction lock for up to ten seconds; process crash or database failure after remote rotation may require manual recovery. A best-effort fail-closed expiry clear is not durable intent.
A provider may have revoked a token even when its response is lost; 503 retains pending state for explicit retry. No automatic remote reconciliation.
Public base native CI does not cover this new local source; own CI must run after publication.
Outbound publishing, policy reconciliation, scheduler, real-provider receipt, UI and full acceptance remain open.
